definition: suggesting something supernatural; uncanny or strange
hook: Weird didn't always mean strange. It used to mean your future was already written.
modernAnchor: A weird coincidence. A weird neighbor. A weird feeling in the back of your neck.
journey: In Old English, wyrd was the force that decided the shape of your life. Older than the gods.
Then Shakespeare wrote Macbeth. He called the three fate-spinning witches the weird sisters.
Audiences saw the witches and the word together. Weird stopped meaning fate. It started meaning witch.
And from witch it became anything strange enough to feel touched by an unseen hand.
